name: Yura
source:
Job: Hermit
Type of Ayakashi: Tsukumo-gami (Dragon Flute)
Signature Trait: An object that has survived long enough to obtain a soul.
Likes: Sweets
Dislikes: N/A

The mysterious Yura lives apart from society with his twin brother, Gaku, in an abandoned shrine. Having lived for over 1,000 years, his wisdom is an invaluable asset to the team. However, a mysterious curse haunts him. Is that why he won’t allow anyone to hear him play his flute...?
